capabilities: Create flashcards in Obsidian using a markup-based block syntax
Sync cards to Anki decks, creating, updating and deleting as needed
Make cloze deletions inside LaTeX math and code blocks
Back up Anki decks automatically before each sync
Assign cards to decks per file or per block and add tags and extra fields
extras: Requires Anki to be running before clicking Sync to Anki; detailed documentation on block types is in an external Tutorial rather than the README; automatic per-deck Anki backups (including scheduling info) are stored in the Anki profile folder and cards removed from the vault are deleted in Anki.
intentEvidence: This project has been inspired from Obsidian_to_Anki. However, this is not a fork
motivation: The author found existing sync plugins could not create clozes inside math and code blocks, so they built this plugin to support that workflow.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create spaced-repetition flashcards or send them to Anki.

relations.evidence: This project has been inspired from Obsidian_to_Anki

summary: Flashcard maker that syncs cards created in Obsidian notes to Anki decks via AnkiConnect.
